principles: Continued presence is not affirmative proof of operation.
No shutdown reported is not affirmative proof of operation.
Launch, interception, penetration, impact, damage, destruction and operational effect are separate predicates.
Stable loss IDs are deduplicated before any physical-quantity aggregate.
Claim-only or target-only quantities are never promoted into verified physical loss totals.
Provider-specific shipping and energy series are not merged across incompatible denominators.

predicate_vocabulary.DAMAGED_BUT_OPERATING: Physical damage and affirmative continued operation established.
predicate_vocabulary.DAMAGED_OPERATIONAL_EFFECT_UNKNOWN: Damage established; current operation not established.
predicate_vocabulary.CONTINUED_PRESENCE_NO_VERIFIED_DAMAGE_OP: Presence established; damage not verified; operation unresolved.
predicate_vocabulary.WITHDRAWN_PREWAR: Administrative withdrawal completed before the war baseline.
predicate_vocabulary.DRAWDOWN_IN_PROGRESS: Administrative/posture drawdown established; not a strike-destruction predicate.

records.name: Naval Support Activity Bahrain / Fifth Fleet HQ area
records.basis: Verified damage; HQ function relocated to MacDill. No evidence that all local NSA Bahrain functions ceased.
records.do_not_infer: HQ relocation does not equal destruction or full local shutdown.

records.name: Al Udeid Air Base
records.basis: SATCOM sites damaged and Combined Air Operations Center reported inoperable. Whole-base shutdown not established.
records.do_not_infer: CAOC inoperable does not equal entire base inoperable.

records.name: Camp Arifjan
records.basis: Communications/radome damage verified; later U.S. troop presence reported.
records.do_not_infer: Troop presence proves presence, not full operational capability.

records.name: Ali Al Salem Air Base
records.basis: Patriot/radome and multiple structures damaged; no whole-site shutdown reported.
records.do_not_infer: Absence of shutdown report is not affirmative proof of operation.

records.name: Camp Buehring
records.basis: Power plant hit and additional damage verified; no whole-site shutdown reported.
records.do_not_infer: No-shutdown reporting does not establish normal operation.

records.name: Port Shuaiba U.S. tactical operations center
records.basis: The specific tactical operations center was destroyed; six U.S. personnel killed.
records.do_not_infer: Destruction of this outpost does not establish destruction of Camp Arifjan or the broader Army network.

records.name: Camp Doha / reported U.S. troop position
records.basis: U.S. troop position reported July 25; Iranian attack/damage claim unverified.
records.do_not_infer: Presence is not proof of full operation; actor attack claim is not damage verification.

records.name: Bubiyan Island / reported relocated U.S. position
records.basis: Relocated U.S. forces/equipment were reported; Iranian strike claim lacks independent damage confirmation.
records.do_not_infer: Reported relocation/presence does not establish permanent-base status or verified loss.

records.name: Al Dhafra Air Base
records.basis: Multiple hangars damaged; contents unknown; whole-base shutdown not established.
records.do_not_infer: Hangar damage does not establish aircraft loss or normal whole-base operation.

records.name: Jebel Ali Port — U.S. Navy logistics/access node
records.basis: Port area used by U.S. naval vessels was hit/burning; U.S.-specific asset damage unresolved.
records.do_not_infer: This is an access/logistics node, not a destroyed U.S. base.

records.name: Erbil military/airport coalition area
records.basis: Attack/damage verified; separate planned Iraq drawdown was in progress.
records.do_not_infer: Do not attribute the drawdown to the strike without evidence.

records.name: Ain al-Asad Air Base (historical U.S. presence)
records.basis: U.S. forces fully withdrew by Jan. 17, 2026.
records.do_not_infer: Not a current-war U.S. facility loss.

records.name: Prince Sultan Air Base
records.basis: E-3/refueling-aircraft damage and personnel casualties established; later U.S. presence/use reported.
records.do_not_infer: Operating does not mean undamaged or full pre-strike capability.

records.name: Muwaffaq al-Salti / Azraq Air Base
records.basis: THAAD damage previously established; Sep. 8 later BDA establishes one severely damaged A-10 and roughly eight lightly damaged F-15s, with the F-15s reported returned to service.
records.do_not_infer: Exact aircraft count/mechanism remains source-bounded; do not convert to whole-base mission kill.

records.name: Incirlik Air Base
records.basis: No credible reviewed strike damage; U.S. Air Force wing activity publicly documented in July.
records.do_not_infer: This is affirmative activity evidence, not merely continued presence.

records.name: Sheikh Isa Air Base
records.basis: Patriot equipment damage verified; whole-base shutdown not reported; broader continuity not fully public.
records.do_not_infer: Do not upgrade no-shutdown reporting to affirmative full operation.

records.name: Rmelan / Kharab al-Jir U.S. base area
records.basis: Retained as of Feb. 23 during broader Syria withdrawal; later presence not independently refreshed in baseline.
records.do_not_infer: No damage report is not proof the site remains active.

records.name: Qasrak / Hasakah former main U.S. base area
records.basis: Withdrawal began Feb. 23; no verified Iranian destruction.
records.do_not_infer: Do not display as intact permanent base or Iranian-destroyed facility.

records.name: al-Tanf garrison (former U.S. base)
records.basis: U.S. withdrawal completed Feb. 12, 2026.
records.do_not_infer: Later Iranian strike claims do not establish destruction of an active U.S. base.

records.name: Barakah Nuclear Energy Plant
records.basis: External electrical generator hit; one reactor automatically shut down; no radiological release; restart status unresolved.
records.do_not_infer: One-unit automatic shutdown does not establish whole-plant destruction or current whole-plant operation.

records.name: Kuwait International Airport
records.basis: Severe terminal damage and flight disruption occurred; Terminal 4 flights later resumed/continued.
records.do_not_infer: Partial resumption does not establish all terminals/functions restored.

records.name: Khondab Heavy Water Production Plant
records.basis: Severe strike damage verified; IAEA reported the facility no longer operational; repair status unresolved.
records.do_not_infer: No evidence of restoration in the accepted record.

records.name: Qatar LNG production/export system
records.basis: Two of 14 LNG trains and a GTL facility were damaged; 12.8 mtpa capacity sidelined for 3-5 years; Reuters reported QatarEnergy had halted production and continued force majeure.
records.do_not_infer: Physical destruction is partial; the broader production halt is an operational state and may reflect both damage and shipping constraints. A Qatar-linked cargo transit does not by itself establish restart.
